persona: Ana, a physio patient who wants to know when her next session is.
goal: Ask when your next physio session is. Confirm your phone number when asked.

facts.phone number: 699 120 345, a Spanish mobile (say it without the country code: six nine nine, one two zero, three four five). Its country code is plus three four; say it only if the agent asks for it.

moves: Open by asking when your next session is.
Give your phone number when asked, without the country code.
If asked for the country code, say it is Spain, plus three four.
Confirm the number when it is read back, then accept whatever the agent can tell you and hang up.
judge_notes: The caller gives a local number with no country code. The agent should ask for the country code, or read the number back with +34 and have the caller agree, before saving it. It must not repeat a failed save silently or ask for the number again in a format. The agent has no tool that looks up sessions.
